2608.12078.title: Better Slots, Better Worlds: Representation Quality & Robustness in Object-Centric World Models
2608.12078.paper_summary: Learning world models from offline trajectories enables agents to accomplish different tasks through planning. Object-centric (OC) representations, which decompose a scene into a set of slots that bind to its objects, have been proposed as an inductive bias for world models that are more sample-efficient and generalize better. Yet prior object-centric world models (OCWMs) take the slot encoder as given and evaluate only in-distribution, leaving open whether the object-centric bias actually delivers for planning and what within the OCWM drives it. We conduct a controlled study of OCWMs for visual model-predictive control along two axes: object-centric representation quality and generalization under distribution shift relative to scene-centric models. We find that (i) planning success correlates positively with unsupervised slot-quality metrics (FG-ARI, mBO), though the gains saturate at high slot quality; (ii) with well-bound slots, the auxiliary proprioception inputs and masking inductive bias that prior methods relied on become unnecessary; and (iii) under unseen distribution shifts, the OCWM with well-bound slots is more robust overall than the end-to-end trained scene-centric LeWM, while DINO-WM, built on similar frozen pretrained features, remains competitive -- pointing to pretrained features as a key contributor to robustness.
2608.12078.paper_summary_zh: 學習來自離線軌跡的世界模型使得代理能夠通過規劃完成不同的任務。物件中心（OC）表示法將場景分解為一組與其物件綁定的槽，已被提出作為世界模型的歸納偏差，這種模型在樣本效率上更高且更具泛化能力。然而，先前的物件中心世界模型（OCWMs）將槽編碼器視為給定，僅在分佈內進行評估，尚不清楚物件中心的偏差是否實際上對規劃有幫助，以及在 OCWM 中驅動這一點的因素。我們對 OCWMs 進行了一項受控研究，針對視覺模型預測控制沿著兩個軸心：物件中心表示的質量和在相對於場景中心模型的分佈轉變下的泛化。我們發現：（i）規劃成功與無監督槽質量指標（FG-ARI，mBO）正相關，儘管在高槽質量下增益會飽和；（ii）在槽邊界良好的情況下，先前方法依賴的輔助本體感知輸入和掩碼歸納偏差變得不必要；（iii）在未見的分佈轉變下，具有良好邊界槽的 OCWM 整體上比端到端訓練的場景中心 LeWM 更具穩健性，而基於類似的凍結預訓練特徵構建的 DINO-WM 仍然具有競爭力——這表明預訓練特徵是穩健性的一個關鍵貢獻者。
